# Checking: how to start everything and check the app

Template from the setup kit. Copy to `.claude/docs/checking.md` once the app runs, keep it under 60 lines, and fill
each section from commands you have actually run. Delete these two lines.

Never print passwords or keys. Say which file or command holds them, never copy them here.

## Start everything (in this order)
Each service the app needs (database, containers, dev server), with the exact command and folder.

## Sign in quickly
Demo accounts or link shortcuts for each side of the app; where their passwords live.

## Email or message codes
Where sign-in codes land locally (a local inbox address), so nothing real is sent while testing.

## Look at a screen
The headless browser command for a viewport screenshot (width, light mode) into `.claude/inbox/`.

## Build
The build command that must pass before any change is reported done.

## Database checks
How to run the security and data checks; if there are no scripts yet, say so and how to check by hand.

## On a phone
How a phone reaches the app (same Wi-Fi, which address), and the native build command.
